items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And another fellow by the name of Svetti (?), he played trumpet.

ctx.x: I never heard of him before.
Yeah, well, he could play. And another fellow by the name of Svetti (?), he played trumpet. And Les? It was a good band. ...
Well, I never heard of Ferman Tapp until Dicky Wells told me he worked for Ferman Tapp back in Louisville in a roadhouse.
